prompt: The drawing of William Buell Sr.'s (1751-1832) house he built, displayed on the historic plaque installed in 2006 at the intersection of Water Street West and Home Street in Brockville, Ontario, was drawn in 1887 by which Brockville artist?
answer: The drawing was made in 1887 by **Brockville artist Frederick C. Gordon**.
